read_spss_load_file: load an SPSS .sav file from a file path and return a pandas DataFrame
read_spss_select_columns: read an SPSS file returning only a subset of specified columns via usecols
read_spss_disable_categoricals: read an SPSS file without converting categorical columns into pd.Categorical
read_spss_nullable_dtypes: read an SPSS file and convert to nullable numpy-backed data types via dtype_backend
read_spss_pyarrow_backend: read an SPSS file and convert to pyarrow-backed nullable ArrowDtype DataFrame
